title: Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and GMAC

methodology: Normative specification of authenticated encryption and usage requirements

title: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3

methodology: Protocol specification with authenticated record protection

limitations: Not a benchmark or agent study

title: Cryptographic Storage Cheat Sheet

methodology: Security guidance on algorithms, keys, secrets, and storage
